sentences.text: suspect Marcus Vance swore under oath he never left the Westside Diner between 9:30 and 11:00 PM.

sentences.speaker: spk_0
sentences.text: But cellular dump records from Tower 4 reveal his phone pinged right here at Pier 9 at 10:14 PM,

sentences.speaker: spk_0
sentences.text: six minutes before his cracked burner phone hit the pavement.

sentences.speaker: spk_0
sentences.text: Which places Vance directly on the pier moments before the harbor security cameras were deliberately severed.

sentences.speaker: spk_0
sentences.text: And what detectives uncovered inside his waterfront locker at midnight changes the motive entirely.
